enriched.title: Gramática e Vocabulário com Verbos Irregulares
enriched.summary: A aula aborda aspectos básicos de gramática, vocabulário e pronúncia, incluindo a conjugação de verbos irregulares e frases no presente simples. Também apresenta expressões comuns e exemplos práticos para fixação.

vocabulary.definition: The majority of a group of people working together.
examples: Most of the team is working remotely.
A maioria do time está de férias.
I visit my parents once a week.
Eu visito meus pais uma vez por semana.

vocabulary.definition: A commonly known phrase or expression.
examples: There's a saying that goes, 'Actions speak louder than words.'
Há um ditado que diz: 'Ações falam mais alto que palavras.'
I get very anxious before exams.

vocabulary.definition: The process of keeping something in good condition.
examples: The building requires regular maintenance.

vocabulary.definition: People with whom one works, especially in a professional setting.
examples: My colleagues are very supportive.
Meus colegas são muito prestativos.

vocabulary.definition: The son of your brother or sister.
examples: My nephew is very good at soccer.
Meu sobrinho é muito bom no futebol.

vocabulary.definition: The daughter of your brother or sister.
examples: My niece loves painting.
Minha sobrinha adora pintar.

vocabulary.definition: To use time inefficiently or unproductively.
examples: Don't waste time on things that don't matter.
Não desperdice tempo com coisas que não importam.

vocabulary.definition: A device or situation designed to catch or deceive someone.
examples: It's a trap, be careful.
É uma armadilha, tenha cuidado.
Look straight ahead.
Olhe diretamente para frente.

grammar.explanation: The present simple is used to describe habits, general truths, and routines.
rules: Add 's' or 'es' to the verb for third-person singular subjects.
examples: Jane speaks German at work.
Jane doesn’t speak German at work.
Does Jane speak German at work?
commonMistakes: Forgetting to add 's' for third-person singular.
Using 'do' instead of 'does' for third-person singular questions.

grammar.explanation: Irregular verbs do not follow the standard rules of conjugation.
rules: Memorize the base form, past simple, and past participle of each irregular verb.
Use the correct form based on the sentence tense.
examples: Sing – sang – sung: cantar
Buy – bought – bought: comprar
commonMistakes: Using the base form instead of the past tense.

practiceQuestions.question: Does Jane speak German at work?
practiceQuestions.explanation: This is a yes/no question in the present simple.

practiceQuestions.question: What language does Jane speak at work?
practiceQuestions.explanation: This is a wh-question in the present simple.

culturalNotes: In English, verbs in the third person singular always take an 's' or 'es' in the present simple.
Social media influencers often impact language trends in English.
studyTips: Practice conjugating irregular verbs daily to improve fluency.
Create flashcards with vocabulary words and their translations for better retention.
